title.zh: 卷六十七 表第七 方鎮四
title.raw: 卷六十七 表第七 方鎮四 Volume 67 Tables 7: Military Commanderies 4

sentences.zh: 表第四 方鎮表四

translations.literal: Table 4, Military Commanderies Table 4.
translations.idiomatic: Table 4: Military Commanderies, Part Four.

sentences.zh: 西元 南陽 山南西道 荊南 安西 河西 隴右 劍南

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Nanyang. Shannan West Circuit. Jingnan. Anxi. Hexi. Longyou. Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Nanyang; Shannan West; Jingnan; Anxi; Hexi; Longyou; Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 副使治甘州，領都知河西兵馬使。

translations.literal: The deputy commissioner had his seat at Gan Prefecture and concurrently held the post of director-general of Hexi military and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy commissioner was stationed at Gan Prefecture, also serving as director-general of Hexi military forces.

sentences.zh: 712 先天元年 北庭都護領伊西節度等使。

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era. The Beiting Protector-General concurrently held the Yixi frontier commissioner and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: In 712, the first year of Xiantian, the Beiting Protector-General was also appointed Yixi frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 713 開元元年

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 719 七年 河西節度增領經略大使。

translations.literal: 719, seventh year. The Hexi circuit military commissioner added concurrent authority as frontier commissioner-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 719, the seventh year of Kaiyuan, the Hexi military commissioner also took the frontier commissioner-general post.

sentences.zh: 升劍南支度、營田、處置、兵馬經略使為節度使，兼昆明軍使，領益、彭、蜀、漢、眉、綿、梓、遂、邛、劍、榮、陵、嘉、普、資、巂、黎、戎、維、茂、簡、龍、雅 、瀘、合二十五州，治益州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan branch disbursement, garrison farm, disposal, and military frontier commissioner was promoted to military commissioner, concurrently holding the Kunming Army commissioner post, holding Yi, Peng, Shu, Han, Mei, Mian, Zi, Sui, Qiong, Jian, Rong, Ling, Jia, Pu, Zi, Xi, Li, Rong, Wei, Mao, Jian, Long, Ya, Lu, and He prefectures—twenty-five in all—with seat at Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan branch disbursement, garrison farm, disposal, and military frontier commissioner was elevated to full military commissioner, also serving as Kunming Army commissioner and commanding twenty-five prefectures—Yi, Peng, Shu, Han, Mei, Mian, Zi, Sui, Qiong, Jian, Rong, Ling, Jia, Pu, Zi, Xi, Li, Rong, Wei, Mao, Jian, Long, Ya, Lu, and He—from his seat at Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 742 天寶元年 劍南節度增領霸州。

translations.literal: 742, first year of the Tianbao era. The Jiannan circuit military commissioner added Ba Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 742, the first year of Tianbao, the Jiannan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Ba Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置興平節度使，領上洛、安康、武當、房陵四郡，治上洛郡。

translations.literal: The Xingping military commissioner was established, holding Shangluo, Ankang, Wudang, and Fangling commanderies—four in all—with seat at Shangluo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A Xingping military commissioner was appointed, commanding four commanderies—Shangluo, Ankang, Wudang, and Fangling—from his seat at Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 置山南西道防禦守捉使。

translations.literal: The Shannan West Circuit defense and garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A defense and garrison commissioner for the Shannan West Circuit was created.

sentences.zh: 置夔州防禦守捉使。

translations.literal: The Kuizhou defense and garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Kuizhou defense and garrison commissioner was established.

sentences.zh: 河西節度兼隴右河西北路，未幾而罷。

translations.literal: The Hexi military commissioner concurrently held the Longyou Hexi North Route post; before long this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hexi military commissioner also took charge of the Longyou Hexi North Route, but the arrangement was soon discontinued.

sentences.zh: 天水郡太守兼防禦守捉使及大震關使。

translations.literal: The Tianshui Commandery grand administrator concurrently held the defense and garrison commissioner post and the Dazhen Pass commissioner post.
translations.idiomatic: The grand administrator of Tianshui Commandery also served as defense and garrison commissioner and commissioner of Dazhen Pass.

sentences.zh: 升夔州防禦為夔峽節度使。

translations.literal: The Kuizhou defense commissioner was promoted to Kuixia military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhou defense commissioner was elevated to Kuixia military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 更安西曰鎮西。

translations.literal: Anxi was changed to Zhenxi.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi was renamed Zhenxi.

sentences.zh: 更劍南節度號西川節度使，兼成都尹，增領果州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan circuit military commissioner was redesignated West Chuan military commissioner, concurrently holding the Chengdu magistrate post, and Guo Prefecture was added to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner became the West Chuan military commissioner, also serving as Chengdu magistrate, with Guo Prefecture added to his command.

sentences.zh: 以梓、遂、綿、劍、龍、閬、普、陵、瀘、榮、資、簡十二州隸東川節度。

translations.literal: Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian prefectures—twelve in all—were placed under the East Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve prefectures—Zi, Sui, Mian, Jian, Long, Lang, Pu, Ling, Lu, Rong, Zi, and Jian—were transferred to the East Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 758 乾元元年 廢夔峽節度使。

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era. The Kuixia military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 758, the first year of Qianyuan, the Kuixia military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以夔、峽、忠、歸、萬五州隸夔州。

translations.literal: Kui, Xia, Zhong, Gui, and Wan prefectures—five in all—were placed under Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Five prefectures—Kui, Xia, Zhong, Gui, and Wan—were transferred to Kuizhou jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 760 上元元年 廢澧朗漵都團練使。

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era. The Li-Lang-Xi chief training commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 760, the first year of Shangyuan, the Li–Lang–Xi chief training commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使兼江陵尹。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner concurrently held the Jiangling magistrate post.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingnan military commissioner also served as Jiangling magistrate.

sentences.zh: 荊南節度復領澧、朗、忠、峽四州。

translations.literal: The Jingnan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over Li, Lang, Zhong, and Xia prefectures—four in all.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction over Li, Lang, Zhong, and Xia prefectures was restored to the Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 罷武關內外四州防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Wuguan Inner and Outer Four Prefectures defense and observation commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The defense and observation commissioner for the four prefectures inside and outside Wuguan Pass was abolished.

sentences.zh: 劍南節度增領通、巴、蓬、渠四州，尋以四州隸山南西道，其後又領松、當、悉、柘、翼、恭、靜、環、真九州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan military commissioner added Tong, Ba, Peng, and Qu prefectures—four in all—to its jurisdiction; soon these four prefectures were placed under the Shannan West Circuit; afterward it again took jurisdiction over Song, Dang, Xi, Zhe, Yi, Gong, Jing, Huan, and Zhen prefectures—nine in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiannan military commissioner gained Tong, Ba, Peng, and Qu prefectures, but soon those four were transferred to the Shannan West Circuit; later it resumed command of nine prefectures—Song, Dang, Xi, Zhe, Yi, Gong, Jing, Huan, and Zhen.

sentences.zh: 置夔忠涪都防禦使，治夔州。

translations.literal: The Kuizhong-Fu chief defense commissioner was established, with seat at Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: A chief defense commissioner for Kuizhong-Fu was appointed, with his seat at Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 劍南西川節度復領東川十五州。

translations.literal: The Jiannan West Chuan military commissioner again took jurisdiction over the East Chuan fifteen prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The West Chuan military commissioner resumed command of the East Chuan fifteen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 765 永泰元年 荊南節度罷領岳州。

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era. The Jingnan military commissioner discontinued jurisdiction over Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 765, the first year of Yongtai, the Jingnan military commissioner relinquished Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置劍南西山防禦使，治茂州，未幾廢。

translations.literal: The Jiannan Western Mountains defense commissioner was established, with seat at Mao Prefecture; before long it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiannan Western Mountains defense commissioner was posted to Mao Prefecture, but the office was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 復以十五州還東川節度。

translations.literal: The fifteen prefectures were again returned to the East Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteen prefectures were once more transferred back to the East Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 780 建中元年 升山南西道觀察使為節度使。

translations.literal: 780, first year of the Jianzhong era. The Shannan West Circuit observation commissioner was promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 780, the first year of Jianzhong, the Shannan West observation commissioner was elevated to military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 785 貞元元年 鄧州隸東都畿。

translations.literal: 785, first year of the Zhenyuan era. Deng Prefecture was placed under the Eastern Capital Metropolitan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 785, the first year of Zhenyuan, Deng Prefecture was transferred to the Eastern Capital Metropolitan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 805 永貞元年 西川節度增領古州。

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era. The West Chuan military commissioner added Gu Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 805, the first year of Yongzhen, the West Chuan military commissioner gained jurisdiction over Gu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 806 元和元年

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: 806 CE, first year of the Yuanhe reign.

sentences.zh: 821 長慶元年

translations.literal: 821, first year of the Changqing era.
translations.idiomatic: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign.

sentences.zh: 825 寶曆元年

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

sentences.zh: 827 大和元年

translations.literal: 827, first year of the Dahe era.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

sentences.zh: 836 開成元年

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

sentences.zh: 841 會昌元年

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

sentences.zh: 847 大中元年

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

sentences.zh: 860 咸通元年

translations.literal: 860, first year of the Xiantong era.
translations.idiomatic: 860 CE, first year of the Xiantong reign.

sentences.zh: 廢定邊軍節度使，復以巂、眉、蜀、邛、雅、嘉、黎七州隸西川節度。

translations.literal: The Dingbian Army military commissioner was abolished; Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li prefectures—seven in all—were again placed under the West Chuan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Dingbian Army military commissioner was abolished, and seven prefectures—Xi, Mei, Shu, Qiong, Ya, Jia, and Li—were restored to the West Chuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 874 乾符元年

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 874 CE, first year of the Qianfu reign.

sentences.zh: 880 廣明元年

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

sentences.zh: 881 中和元年

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 置彭州防禦使。

translations.literal: The Pengzhou defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Pengzhou defense commissioner was appointed.

sentences.zh: 置武定軍節度使，治洋州。

translations.literal: The Wuding Army military commissioner was established, with seat at Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Wuding Army military commissioner was appointed, with his seat at Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 889 龍紀元年

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era.
translations.idiomatic: 889 CE, first year of the Longji reign.

sentences.zh: 890 大順元年

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

sentences.zh: 894 乾寧元年

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era.
translations.idiomatic: 894 CE, first year of the Qianning reign.

sentences.zh: 901 天復元年

translations.literal: 901, first year of the Tianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.

sentences.zh: 904 天祐元年

translations.literal: 904, first year of the Tianyou era.
translations.idiomatic: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.

sentences.zh: 置興文節度使，領興、文、集、壁四州，治興州。

translations.literal: The Xingwen military commissioner was established, holding Xing, Wen, Ji, and Bi prefectures—four in all—with seat at Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Xingwen military commissioner was appointed, commanding four prefectures—Xing, Wen, Ji, and Bi—from his seat at Xing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升夔忠涪防禦使為鎮江節度使。

translations.literal: The Kuizhong-Fu defense commissioner was promoted to Zhenjiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuizhong-Fu defense commissioner was elevated to Zhenjiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 文州隸興文節度。

translations.literal: Wen Prefecture was placed under the Xingwen military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Prefecture was transferred to the Xingwen military commissioner.

sentences.zh: PD-icon.svg 本北宋作品在全世界都属于公有领域，因为作者逝世已经遠遠超过100年。

translations.literal: PD-icon.svg This Northern Song work belongs to the public domain worldwide, because the author died more than one hundred years ago by a wide margin.
translations.idiomatic: This Northern Song work is in the public domain worldwide, as the author's death lies far more than a century in the past.
